Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

party — a social event with friends. Example: I would like to have a party.
event — an organised occasion. Example: It is a big event.
celebrate — to do something special for an occasion. Example: We would like to celebrate in the park.
music — sounds made with voices or instruments. Example: There is music and food.
food — what people eat. Example: I bring some food.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• We would like to celebrate ...
• The event is on ...
• There is music and food.
• Twenty friends come.
• It is a big event.

Present a celebration plan: what, when, where and who. Use would like to and the present simple: We would like to celebrate in the park. There is music and food.
